instruction: NaLonni's 2026-09-29 request: fix the brand icon references. public/brand/ is missing app-icon-180.png, app-icon-192.png, app-icon-512.png, and faviconKolmari.svg, but src/app/layout.tsx references the 180px apple icon and the SVG favicon, and src/app/manifest.ts references the 192/512px icons. Generate public/brand/app-icon-180.png (180x180), app-icon-192.png (192x192), and app-icon-512.png (512x512) from the existing public/brand/favicon-512.png via downscaling, and remove the faviconKolmari.svg entry from the layout icons (no SVG favicon exists; favicon.ico plus the PNGs cover it). manifest.ts needs no change once the PNGs exist. Nothing else.
supersedeNote: sld-037 shipped the growth + hardening release. It is archived at .sld/archive/sld-037-growth-hardening-release.json. This contract covers only the brand icon fix.
objective: Make every brand icon reference resolve to a real file without touching anything outside the listed files or the SLD engine itself. The maintenance grant is declared solely to archive superseded sld-037 under .sld/.
